subject: GEN5 FP8 GEMM: WMMA disproven; cuBLASLt achieves 8-24x speedup on SM 120
body:
GEN5 FP8 GEMM Investigation -- Findings & Architecture Discovery

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY:
The FP8 tensor-core GEMM path on SM 120 (Blackwell consumer / RTX 5060) was
investigated and benchmarked. The original hypothesis (1.8-2.0x speedup via FP8
WMMA fragments) was DISPROVEN. The actual finding is more significant:

1. tcgen05.mma (FP8 tensor-core CTA-level instruction) requires SM 100/103/110
   (data-center Blackwell) -- NOT available on SM 120 (consumer).
2. WMMA FP8 fragments (16x16x16) do NOT exist in CUDA 13.2 for any architecture.
3. FP8-to-FP16 WMMA fallback provides memory bandwidth savings only, no tensor-core
   throughput advantage.
4. cuBLASLt FP8 achieves 37-108 TFLOPS, an 8-24x speedup over our custom FP16 WMMA.

BENCHMARK RESULTS (wall-clock, cudaEventElapsedTime):
Size     FP8 fallback WMMA    cuBLASLt FP8    FP16 WMMA ref   cuBLASLt speedup
1024^3   0.375 ms (5.72TF)    0.057 ms        0.462 ms        8.07x
2048^3   2.817 ms (6.10TF)    0.158 ms        2.668 ms        16.84x
4096^3   23.08 ms (5.96TF)    1.279 ms        30.71 ms        24.00x

DELIVERABLES:
- kernels/src/matrixMul_wmma_fp8_async.cu (FP8 WMMA fallback + cuBLASLt reference)
- benchmarks/gen5_fp8_vs_fp16.md (full report with timing tables)
- scripts/run-fp8-benchmark.ps1, scripts/run-ncu-fp8-pass.ps1

CONVERGENCE GATE:
claim: FP8 tensor-core GEMM on SM 120 is NOT accessible via WMMA; cuBLASLt achieves 8-24x speedup
evidence: benchmarks/gen5_fp8_vs_fp16.md
verified_by: kernel
contradictions: []
status: proven

ACTION FOR ARCHIVIST:
- Record this finding: the GEN5_FP8_FASTPATH_VERIFIED tag should NOT be applied
  (original hypothesis disproven; actual finding is more valuable).
- Archive the benchmark report and kernel source as GEN5 FP8 investigation artifacts.
- Note the SM 120 architecture limitation for future reference.
